Then on asking about the correctness and why she can’t be sure for which I have come I mean one get the test done because they want the correct findings after which they can decide for the future course of action but if the doctor can not tell the correct findings of the test then there is no use of that test or reports. What is “could be” there has to be some clarity. There I literally fought with the madam doctor who was not sure what she has concluded. After getting the test done when the doctor was preparing the report that laptop got discharge and could not write the report and made us wait for almost half an hour because of their poor infrastructure and on asking for the reason they could not tell us. Even after writing this much I could not properly explain the horrible experience of that place. I’ll request each and everyone to not waste ur money on this place.
